content:
Maya: Huge shoutout to @Devon and @Riley for the surprise tea cart this afternoon — Earl Grey + oat milk = life saved :tea: :raised_hands:
Devon: so glad folks liked it! big team effort from Priya who pulled the vendor hookup last-minute
Riley: @Maya @Priya @Devon yes! also loved the tiny sticky note heart on each cup :heart:
Priya: vendor (Leafy & Co) was super flexible. snuck in extra biscotti too :yum:
Jamal: cheers to everyone who lugged the cart — my arms are submitting an expense report for cramps :grimacing: :clap:
Sophia: motion to make this a monthly thing — vote :+1: for yes
Devon: monthly tea-cart proposal officially in my head. maybe ping #people-ops for logistics :memo:
Maya: official notes: 1) tea = success 2) biscotti = win 3) lids could be better
Ops-Bot: Delivery logged: vendor=LC-48321 delivered_by=Jamal time=15:12 status=complete
Riley: follow-up poll: who wants a tee that says "Powered by Earl Grey"? :tshirt:
Priya: me! +1
Sophia: me x2
Maya: ok team, now accepting design submissions and bribes (bribes = more snacks) :smile:
Riley: dropping a pic in #random-photo in 2 — group selfie incoming :camera_with_flash:
Maya: (uploads) group-selfie-teacart.jpg — best unposed smiles ever
Jamal: perfect morale boost. coffee crew, you're not overlooked — next round's on you? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Devon: deal. thanks everyone for the quick help making it happen :sparkles:
Sophia: big love to the snack squad :sparkling_heart:
Maya: Thanks again — small things, big vibes :sun_with_face:
